description: This is a Kotlin source file defining a 3D OpenGL ES renderer class 'Plot3DRenderer' used for rendering radar points as GL_POINTS within an Android application. It manages shaders, VBOs, and rendering pipeline details for drawing 3D radar data.

classes.name: Plot3DRenderer
classes.description: A Kotlin class implementing an OpenGL ES 2.0 renderer for rendering 3D radar points in an Android application.

methods.name: updatePoints
methods.description: Updates the VBO with a list of RadarPoint objects, normalizing their coordinates and uploading the data to GPU memory for rendering.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL settings and creates shader programs when the rendering surface is created.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts the viewport and projection matrix when the surface dimensions change.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Executes the rendering commands to draw the radar points each frame.

methods.name: updateViewMatrix
methods.description: Calculates the camera view matrix based on zoom and angles.

methods.name: updateMvp
methods.description: Computes and updates the combined Model-View-Projection matrix.

methods.name: loadShader
methods.description: Compiles a shader of a given type with provided GLSL source code.

methods.name: createProgram
methods.description: Creates and links an OpenGL shader program from vertex and fragment shader sources.
